facts.note: Girard sat alone in the dining room with the brandy after dinner; at the temple's ten strokes his watch showed four minutes to ten.
He went out into the street at twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch, with a cigar, and stayed under the front windows.
The piano started in the salon as he lit his cigar, at twenty-nine minutes past ten by his watch, and stopped at eighteen minutes to eleven by his watch.
At twenty-six minutes to eleven by his watch he heard faint quick bells from the master's window above, with the piano playing all the while.
He came back in at fourteen minutes to eleven by his watch; the hall clock had just struck eleven and its face showed two minutes past eleven; he then went up to Félix in the library.
